modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_weight.value: Domestic Economy 5kg; International Economy 7kg; International Business 10kg.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Economy (domestic and international): max 105cm = 48(w) + 34(h) + 23cm(d). International Business: max 115cm = 56(w) + 36(h) + 23cm(d).

personal_item.value: In addition to the allowance: a laptop in a thin case, a handbag or purse, an overcoat or blanket, an umbrella or walking stick, a small camera or binoculars, reading matter and infant food for the flight.

infant.value: Adults travelling with infants may take an additional 7kg of cabin baggage free of charge for essential baby products.

modules.lede: The cabin allowance can be two briefcases or small bags, or one small bag plus one suit pack, and must fit under the seat or in an overhead locker.

allowance.value: International Economy 30 kg (40 kg for Belama Plus / Flexible Economy); International Business 40 kg (50 kg); Domestic Economy 16 kg.

max_piece.value: No single item of checked baggage can exceed 32kg.

oversize.value: Items over 158cm (length + width + height) up to 277cm are bulky items and pay a bulky item fee at the airport (for example SBD350 at Honiara, AUD75 at Brisbane) on top of any excess; pieces over 277cm must go as freight.

connections.value: International allowances apply to a domestic connection on the same ticket when both flights are operated by Solomon Airlines.

phone_home_market.notes: Solomon Airlines official customer support line in Honiara.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.
